_note: Indicative prices (USD per image) measured on the CogFoundry gateway, used ONLY to print an indicative range on a fresh clone where no price has been observed yet. They are never folded into a quote or a total. An observed price in references/price-observations.json (written by real runs) always wins. A hint is shown only for text-to-image rows with an explicit quality (never for reference calls or 'auto' quality, which bill differently), and is ignored 180 days after the measured date. Reference calls (a photo sent with the request) are hinted only on an exact key, because they bill about twice a text call: the one reference hint is a real measurement of two calls on 2026-10-10.
